name: Body sensors in background
plain: Lets the app read heart rate and similar vitals while not on screen.
meaning: Continuous health monitoring: sleep, stress and arrhythmia patterns. Replaced by READ_HEALTH_DATA_IN_BACKGROUND for apps targeting Android 16.

android.prompt_ui: Settings-level grant after the foreground body sensors grant
android.api_surface: SensorManager in a foreground service of type health
android.note: Needs BODY_SENSORS first; Android 14 added the health foreground service type.

ios.prompt_ui: Uses the same per-type read toggles
ios.note: Background delivery wakes the app at most hourly for most types (frequency can be limited).

data.update: hourly background delivery on iOS; continuous with Android health foreground service

limits.headline: Can keep checking your heart rate and vitals while the app is not on screen
limits.user_action: You first allow body sensors, then turn on background access in Settings
can: See heart rate and similar vitals in a health foreground service on Android
Wake on iPhone when new health data arrives, if you allowed that type
Keep tracking a long workout or sleep in the background
cannot: Get background access without the foreground body sensors permission first on Android
Wake on iPhone more than about once an hour for most data types
See data types you did not allow in the Health sheet
Work after you turn the permission off
limits.reach_label: Ongoing, but only vitals you allowed
limits.differs: Android needs a second Settings grant. iPhone uses a background delivery setting and the same per type switches.

story.what_it_is: Lets an app read heart rate and similar readings even when it is not on screen.

marketing.name: Health Connect background access
marketing.pitch: Developer guide: apps can ask separate permission to read health data while not in use.

story.for_you: A second pop up asks to read body sensors all the time. If you say yes, the app can watch heart rate while closed, such as through the night. That is more personal than a workout reading.
story.for_makers: Needed for sleep tracking, stress alerts and warnings about odd heart rhythms. Android 16 replaces it with a health background permission for apps that target it.

use_cases.example: A watch app warns you of a high resting heart rate while the phone is in your pocket.
A sleep app reads heart rate through the night to score your sleep.
A training app watches recovery vitals all day and suggests a rest day.
A watch app logs stress readings in the background.
A heart research app gathers passive readings for a long study.
A wellness plan could reward steady vitals if you share the data.
An ad firm could infer health problems from nightly vitals if leaked.

story.ios_note: iPhone allows background health reads through HealthKit with your approval.

technical_bounds: Needs the foreground grant first on Android
iOS uses an entitlement for background delivery

history.change: Replaced for apps targeting 36 by READ_HEALTH_DATA_IN_BACKGROUND
